provenance.timestamp_encoding: UTC integer microseconds since 1970-01-01; native osmium defaults may represent absent metadata
provenance.node_coordinate_encoding: Integer degrees * 1e7, native OSM coordinate precision; point geometry available as a SQLite view
provenance.area_note: Derived geometry keyed by original way/relation ID; not another independent source entity

caveats: No administrative assignment, semantic validation, physical deduplication or missing-tag imputation.
Nodes/ways/relations are one graph, not independent real-world object counts.
Building source records remain in the separately referenced immutable building release; external rows are pointers, not duplicates.
All ways have original ordered references; available LineStrings do not imply polygon semantics.
Areas are additional derived geometries, not independent source entities. Not every closed way is a real-world area.
Non-area relations retain ordered members and roles; routes/restrictions are NOT flattened into invented polygons.
Missing references already absent from the input may remain unresolved. No claim that every referenced object exists.
Empty source tag arrays are stored as SQL NULL and reconstruct as []; no tags were discarded.
Metadata presence flags unavailable from native API: default zero/empty/epoch must not be mistaken for observed facts.
